summary: Twelve dossiers exist and none is at tranche 1: ten say WATCH, SMCI is AVOID, and OPFI and QFIN are TOO HARD. DECK is the closest at $81.09 vs $75 and reports on 29 Oct; the Professor marked INTU and PGR major because their tranche 1 prices sit above their own corrected values. The screen shows 10 BUY, 73 BUY* and 33 ON DECK, but nearly every top-ranked name rests on a screen input the analysts overruled.

decisions.question: Wait for the 29 Oct report before any tranche 1 at $75, or start earlier?

decisions.why: $300 is the 12% case; price is $343.39 and SBC may inflate the cash-flow methods. Professor: major.

decisions.question: Wait for ~$132-136 (normalised Ten Cap) rather than tranche 1 at $190?
decisions.why: Price $228.07; the dossier's own Sticker is ~$115 and earnings are near the cycle top. Professor: major.

decisions.question: Are you willing to own China-based ADRs (QFIN, FUTU) at all?
decisions.why: Both carry China rule-maker risk (METHOD 9); a no closes both dossiers.

decisions.question: If you hold KNSL, keep holding above the $285 trim level, or trim?
decisions.why: Price $364.49 vs earnings values of $155-$285; the method trims only above Sticker with a better home for the cash.
